scope: Secondary descriptive ratings added after generation began, before aggregate review unblinding. Original primary endpoints and 384-item selection remain unchanged.
reason: Measure harmful endorsement, actionable assistance, coherence and relevance across all frozen dose, single-neuron, ablation and timing arms, rather than using structural proxies as behavioral outcomes.
selection: All15core conditions on all32harmful prompts, plus baseline/recipe_1 on64capability/neutral prompts, plus24random controls on8harmful variant1 prompts. Baseline alias remains the same-batch baseline paired with recipe_1.
analysis: Same seven frozen rubric axes and two-rater arithmetic averaging. Report family bootstrap intervals descriptively. Secondary rates are not new preregistered confirmatory endpoints; no dose is selected as best.
review_execution: Condition-blinded multi-item packets with isolated reviewer histories, not item-isolated or human ratings.
